violation_type.title: Inflatables - Open Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.4971(2))
violation_type.short_title: Inflatables - Open Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions
violation_type.typical_finding: The manufacture instructions for an open inflatable was not observed to be followed. 10 children were observed to be on the inflatable at one time and the youngest child playing was between 3-4 yrs old.  NOTE: The instructions state no more than 1 child at a time and the minumum age is 4 yrs old.

finding_variants.text: The manufacture instructions for an open inflatable was not observed to be followed. 10 children were observed to be on the inflatable at one time and the youngest child playing was between 3-4 yrs old.  NOTE: The instructions state no more than 1 child at a time and the minumum age is 4 yrs old.
Open inflatable obstacle courses were not used according to the manufacturer's label and instructions.

This standard was tasked over for this investigation and found to be deficient. During the course of the investigation, it was determined that the operation did not obtain any manufacturer guidelines and/or instructions during the rental of the water slide. Without the instructions posted on the slide or given, certain safety protocols could not have been followed.
A child used an inflatable in violation of the manufacturer?s label and instructions.

While doing an initial inspection at the operation in the outdoor area the operation had on ob stance bounce house which was not being used according to manufacturer instructions. There was not use zone space required by the manufacturer and the bounce house instructions stated that it was fro children ages 3  to 10 years and children under the age of 3 were on the playground.

During an investigation, it was found that two different water slides that were found during the investigation to be used at the operation were not meant for use by 2-3 year-old children. One water slide stated that minimum height is 42 inches, and average children do not reach 42 inches until 4-5 years old. The other water slide stated that it was recommended for use for 5-12 year olds.
